expected_steps.name: Insert dowels and attach bottom rails
expected_steps.description: Insert wooden dowels into the ends of the two long square rails and seat them into the side ladder frame.

expected_steps.name: Insert barrel nuts and tighten long bolts
expected_steps.description: Insert barrel nuts into the side slots of the rails and fasten with long bolts using the Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Rotate frame onto base
expected_steps.description: Rotate the assembled partial frame 90 degrees downward so the ladder frame rests flat on the floor and the rails point upward.

expected_steps.name: Attach vertical side posts
expected_steps.description: Insert wooden dowels into the upright post ends and mount the two vertical upright posts onto the base frame.

expected_steps.name: Insert 6 metal rack tubes
expected_steps.description: Slide 6 hollow metallic shoe rack tubes vertically into the pre-drilled holes in the bottom horizontal rails.

expected_steps.name: Fold cardboard alignment template tabs
expected_steps.description: Fold up the perforated corner tabs on the flat cardboard tube-alignment guide sheet.

expected_steps.name: Position cardboard alignment template
expected_steps.description: Lower the folded cardboard template over the top ends of the 6 vertical metal tubes to hold them parallel and aligned.

expected_steps.name: Mount top ladder frame
expected_steps.description: Align and lower the top ladder frame onto the upright wooden posts and the top ends of the 6 metal tubes.

expected_steps.name: Fasten top frame hex bolts
expected_steps.description: Insert short hex bolts into the top outer holes and fasten with the Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Remove and discard cardboard template
expected_steps.description: Tear or slide out the cardboard alignment template from between the metal tubes and discard it.

expected_steps.name: Flip bench assembly onto side
expected_steps.description: Rotate the entire assembly onto its side to expose the underside corner joints.

expected_steps.name: Fasten remaining side hex bolts
expected_steps.description: Insert and tighten the remaining short hex bolts into the lower frame joints using the Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Mount frame onto top seat panel
expected_steps.description: Lay the solid top seat panel face-down on the floor, place the assembled frame onto it, and secure using screws with the Allen key.
